rust_summary: read-only chunk snapshots (`native_chunk_snapshot`) with block map colours and biome tints (`native_block_map_color`, `native_biome_name`, `native_biome_tint`).
doc_summary: `native_chunk_snapshot(dimension, chunk)`, a read-only `NativeChunkSnapshot` of a loaded chunk (block states, surface heights, biomes) that can be read on another thread, with `native_block_map_color(state)`, `native_biome_name(biome)` and `native_biome_tint(biome, x, z)` to draw it. Bundles need "hooks": @API:chunk_snapshot@.
